user.title: Proscenic 830P
user.description: Local Tuya LAN (port 6668). ProscenicHome login fetches the local_key once; it is not stored.

login.title: ProscenicHome
login.description: ProscenicHome email or phone plus the app password (not an Apple ID). Germany = country code 49. After a lockout wait 5 minutes and try once.

mfa.title: ProscenicHome code
mfa.description: A 6-digit code was sent to the ProscenicHome email. Enter it once.

error.cannot_connect: ProscenicHome API error — check HA logs
error.too_frequent: ProscenicHome rate limit — wait a minute, then try again
error.password_locked: Too many wrong passwords. Wait 5 minutes, then try the app password once
